name: Foundation of Genesis
description: Those that abide by the teachings of Tapu Lele find themselves adept at identifying life, able to discern Greater Beasts and animals more easily.
effect: Devotees of the Spirit Guardian of Genesis may call upon 'Foundation of Genesis' once per quest as a bonus action to summon Psychic Terrain. At Luminary, they may expend 1 Will when their Terrain would end for any reason. If they do so, they retain a personalized Psychic Terrain that only affects them and can exist with another Terrain. This personalized Terrain lasts for 4 Turns. Furthermore, at Luminary, only Enemies cannot use Priority Moves targeting you or your allies under the effects of your Psychic Terrain. At Paragon, as long as any Terrain is active the User gains a Base +1 Def and Sp. Def.
